resources.string: Run the game on this device. Other players join this device, then use Download Play or their own copy of the game.
Sessions on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot appear here. If one doesn\'t show up, type the host\'s address.
Not connected to Wi-Fi or a hotspot

• Turn on the hotspot on one phone and connect the other to it, or put both on the same 5 GHz Wi-Fi.
• Turn off battery saver on both devices.
• Start the session here before launching a game or Download Play.
• Download Play needs DS BIOS and firmware dumps on the receiving device.
• A PC running melonDS can join or host too: System → Multiplayer → Host/Join LAN game.
Now pick a game and open its multiplayer or Download Play menu. Keep this session running.
Open DS Download Play to receive the host\'s game, or pick your own copy for multi-card play.

Higher survives worse Wi-Fi without \"communication error\", at the cost of brief slowdowns.
Couldn\'t host. Is another session already running on this device?
Couldn\'t connect to %1$s. Check that both devices are on the same network.
Pauses briefly while a console answers during the Download Play / multiplayer connection, so Wi-Fi latency doesn\'t trigger \"communication error\". Leave on unless asked.
